answer: What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The ledge holds work receipts rather than names, so the yarrow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
